interpretations: For each budget line, sum all linked expense costs; compare that total with the average of those totals across budget lines that have expenses. Report the qualifying lines’ average total, their combined expense count, and their average dollar amount above the benchmark

For each budget line, sum all linked expense costs, treating lines with no expenses as zero; compare that total with the average across all budget lines. Report the qualifying lines’ average total, their combined expense count, and their average dollar amount above the benchmark

For each budget line, sum all linked expense costs; compare that total with the average `budget.spent` value across budget lines. Report the qualifying lines’ average expense total, their combined expense count, and their average dollar amount above that benchmark
queries:
WITH budget_totals AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_budget,
           SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost,
           COUNT(*) AS expense_count
    FROM expense AS e
    GROUP BY e.link_to_budget
),
benchmark AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_total
    FROM budget_totals
)
SELECT AVG(bt.total_cost) AS average_total,
       SUM(bt.expense_count) AS combined_expense_count,
       AVG(bt.total_cost - b.average_total) AS average_amount_above_benchmark
FROM budget_totals AS bt
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE bt.total_cost > b.average_total

WITH line_totals AS (
    SELECT b.budget_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost,
           COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.budget_id
),
benchmark AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_total
    FROM line_totals
)
SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS average_total,
       SUM(l.expense_count) AS combined_expense_count,
       AVG(l.total_cost - b.average_total) AS average_amount_above_benchmark
FROM line_totals AS l
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE l.total_cost > b.average_total

WITH benchmark AS (
    SELECT AVG(spent) AS avg_spent
    FROM budget
),
line_totals AS (
    SELECT b.budget_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS expense_total,
           COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.budget_id
)
SELECT AVG(lt.expense_total) AS average_expense_total,
       SUM(lt.expense_count) AS combined_expense_count,
       AVG(lt.expense_total - benchmark.avg_spent) AS average_amount_above_benchmark
FROM line_totals AS lt
CROSS JOIN benchmark
WHERE lt.expense_total > benchmark.avg_spent
